chunks.title: SecureVault AI — overview
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Next-gen cloud security platform. File encryption meets AI-powered threat detection — AES-256-GCM encryption that runs locally, an AI threat scanner, biometric login, a blockchain key vault and zero-knowledge sharing.
Source code: https://github.com/Nausheen1295/securevault-ai
Live demo: https://securevaultai-brown.vercel.app

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — problem & solution
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Solution: Encrypt files on the user's own device so they never leave it, and pair that with automated threat scanning, passwordless biometric login and auditable key storage.

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — features
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Features:
- AES-256-GCM file encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation (310k iterations)
- Random salt & IV per file; batch file processing; 100% local — files never leave your device
- AI threat scanner: Shannon entropy analysis, file-signature matching, confidence scoring
- VirusTotal API integration
- Biometric authentication via WebAuthn (fingerprint / platform authenticators) — zero biometric data stored
- Blockchain key vault on the Ethereum Sepolia testnet with MetaMask, immutable audit trail and key revocation
- Zero-knowledge sharing: password never in the share URL, expiring links, max view count, one-click revocation, checksum verification
- Security analytics: real-time security score, threat history charts, event audit log, risk dashboard

chunks.title: SecureVault AI — architecture
chunks.text:
Project: SecureVault AI (Security Lab). Status: Live — Shipped and publicly available.
Architecture components:
- User (client): Signs in with a password or a WebAuthn platform authenticator (fingerprint / face). No biometric data is stored by the app.
- React + Vite app (frontend): Single-page app built with React 18 and Vite 5, deployed on Vercel. Hosts the dashboard, scanner, vault and sharing UI.
- Encryption engine (ai): AES-256-GCM with keys derived through PBKDF2 (310k iterations) and a random salt + IV per file. Runs locally, so files never leave the device.
- AI threat scanner (ai): Analyses files with Shannon entropy and signature matching, produces a confidence score, and can cross-check with the VirusTotal API.
- Serverless API (api): The repository contains an api/ directory alongside the Vercel config. Its exact responsibilities are not documented yet.
- Blockchain key vault (data): Key records are stored on the Ethereum Sepolia testnet through MetaMask, giving an immutable audit trail with support for key revocation.
- VirusTotal (external): External threat-intelligence service used by the scanner for additional verification.
Data flow: user → frontend; frontend → crypto; frontend → scanner; frontend → api; scanner → virustotal; frontend → chain.
